title: Performing Arts Center

services.name: Summer Camps
services.desc: Join us for an unforgettable summer experience with our camps and intensives designed for all ages! Explore multiple genres as you learn from talented teachers who are experts in their fields. Whether you're a beginner or looking to hone your skills, our programs offer something for everyone. Embrace creativity, make new friends and crafts. Enjoy a summer filled with inspiration and fun! Click on the Summer Brochure link above to find a registration tab. Fill the form out and either mail or return to our office. Locate the Register tab at the top of the screen to sign up through a parent portal system. Check out our studio! We would love to give you a tour and sign up for classes in person.

services.name: Adult Ballet
services.desc: Our beginner classes are designed to spark a love of dance that lasts a lifetime. As your child learns and grows, they'll develop confidence, coordination, and poise, while making friends who share their passion. Dance has a way of lifting our spirits and bringing us joy - and we can't think of a more wonderful way to move and groove! PRE-SCHOOL-1 BALLET/TAP (Ages 3 - 4) & BEGINNER-1 BALLET/TAP (ages 4 - 6): These one-hour combination classes, about 40 minutes in ballet shoes and 20 in tap shoes, will explore a variety of movements to build major motor skills in a ballet setting. Using ballet music, familiar pre-school, seasonal & holiday tunes, themes, imagination and a variety of props,

blurb: Since1974, the Davenports have passionately owned and directed this amazing studio, once known as the Barbara Jeanne School of Dance. We've joyfully journeyed from Kingshighway to Main Street, and now we proudly call Country Club Plaza Drive ours! At PAC, our hearts are all about the children - we absolutely adore them!
